What is answered by Namaskara from Bangalore International Airport Limited. Thank you for contacting us. If you’re looking for slot booking at BLR, the PreSecure Lane (EZPass by BLR) is available only at Terminal 1, Zone D security checkpoint, Level 0. You can book your security slot through the BLR Pulse app, and it is meant to help you choose a preferred time to join the security queue. **Terminal 1 Options** > **PreSecure Lane (EZPass by BLR)** > **Zone:** Terminal 1 - Zone D Security Checkpoint, Level 0 > This is a queue access management facility, not a fast-track security service. You need a valid boarding pass and a QR code generated in the BLR Pulse app. Slots open up to 4 hours before departure and are not permitted within 60 minutes of departure. Please arrive within your booked time window, ideally within ±5 minutes. > **Reference:** [Click here for more details](https://www.bengaluruairport.com/ezpass) To book it, open the BLR Pulse app, upload or scan your boarding pass, choose your preferred slot, and then complete the booking. If you need help at the airport, you may also approach the terminal staff near Zone D security. > **Reference:** [Click here for more details](https://www.bengaluruairport.com/ezpass) If you’d like, I can also help you with the booking window, eligibility, or where exactly to go in Terminal 1.?
